procstep.procdesc: Consolidated Data Basin Info: Establish base of historical land cover based on re-defined attributes of the Kuchler data (kuchler) Edit the initial data using the Hall 1885 medium scale irrigation maps for the location of historical wetlands, Tulare Lake, Summit Lake, Buena Vista Lake, and Kern Lake. (Hallmedscale) Edit the initial data using the Piemeisel map along with reconnaissance soil surveys for the location of historical scrub lands unmapped in the initial data. (Piemeisel, recon_midsjv, recon_uppsjv, recon_lowsjv) Develop a layer showing the extent of irrigated lands around 1912 using USDA data and add in the estimated extent of urban areas using reconnaissance soil survey base maps. (irr1912, recon_midsjv, recon_uppsjv, recon_lowsjv) Develop a layer showing the extent of irrigated lands and some urban lands around 1945 using map in USBR report. (USBR1949) Develop a layer showing the extent of urban and irrigated farmland around 1977 using USGS LULC data (USGSLULC) Derived a layer of irrigated agricultre and urban areas using ESRP land use and land cover data (ESRPLULC) Used Arc/Info overlay analysis (UNION) to combine layers and assign land use/land cover attributes for potential land cover and land cover during subsequent time frames. Clipped data to boundary of the Great Central Valley region of California (UCSB, 1996) south of latitude 38 N (gapjepson)
